def parse_duration(duration)
  unless duration.match?(/\A(?:[0-9]+[hms])+\z/)
    raise ArgumentError, "expected a duration like 1h30m or 45s"
  end

  seconds_per_unit = { "h" => 3600, "m" => 60, "s" => 1 }
  duration.scan(/([0-9]+)([hms])/).sum do |amount, unit|
    amount.to_i * seconds_per_unit.fetch(unit)
  end
end
